for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    if "__" not in filename:
        continue
    date_part, rest = filename.split("__", 1)
    # rest is like "slides.ppt" or "video_recording.mp4"
    # Split on last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = rest
        ext = ""
    # New directory name: file_name
    new_dir = base_dir + file_name
    # Create directory if not exists
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # New file path: new_dir + "/" + date_part + "." + ext
    if ext:
        new_filename = date_part + "." + ext
    else:
        new_filename = date_part
    dest_path = new_dir + "/" + new_filename
    # Move file
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_path)
    print(f"Moved {file_path} to {dest_path}: {result}")
